ntn_latency_ms.notes: LEO round-trip latency order-of-magnitude consistent with TR 38.821 NTN delay discussion derived from satellite altitude/geometry context. Not a device measurement. Sensitivity analysis spans the declared range [20, 60] ms.

ntn_capacity_mbps.notes: Conservative service-capacity planning value within TR-informed NTN scenario ranges. Sensitivity spans [1, 20] Mbps. Not a campaign throughput measurement.

ntn_availability.notes: Scenario availability fraction for sensitivity; not measured orbit pass statistics. Sensitivity spans [0.5, 0.99].

statistics.ci_warning: 95% Student-t CIs quantify simulation-run variability across seeds, NOT real-world RF or operator performance uncertainty.
